verdict.rationale: Delegated access is a fair question for a state business registry, but the evidence pack never describes what a third party (filer, agent, attorney) may or may not do on an entity's behalf, any authorization forms, or which signatures must stay personal. The typed-signature rule (s.15.16, F.S.) only covers how a signature is made, not who may sign. The registered-agent change option is an adjacent feature, not a published delegation policy.
